hints.title: Complete Tree Indexing
hints.text: Assign position index i to a node, where its left child receives index two times i and right child receives index two times i plus one.

hints.title: Level Width Difference
hints.text: At each depth, the width is the difference between the maximum index and minimum index plus one.

hints.title: Normalize Against Overflow
hints.text: To avoid numeric overflow in deeply unbalanced trees, subtract the leftmost index of the current level from all node indices at that level before expanding children.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the binary tree
complexity.notes: Level-order traversal tracking 0-based column indices with per-tier offset subtraction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded heap indexing across deep skewed trees causes 64-bit integer overflow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Normalizing each tier index relative to the leftmost node prevents large numbers without extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 2 * idx and 2 * idx + 1 indexing and subtract the first index of each tier to prevent integer overflow.
